name: What happens after a wind damage roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a wind damage roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a wind damage roof inspection, Discounted Roofing Co. will provide you with a detailed report of the findings and recommended next steps, which may include repairs or replacement. If repairs are needed, we can assist you with the insurance claim process and provide a comprehensive estimate. We then schedule the necessary work at your convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: After inspection, you'll receive a detailed report and recommendations. We assist with insurance claims and schedule repairs.
